name: Reef Star Shrine — structural sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Coral-limestone/ivory star shrine with radiating pointed roof/gable forms, small gold finials, shell capitals, central stepped entry and shallow tidal pool surround. Coral-like branches appear as architectural ornament and reef context, not proven living organism assets. Hidden layout inference: One raised reef path meets a dry arrival step, then a small star court beneath the pointed canopy. A low viewing ring watches tidal pools and returns to shore; maintain a clear dry route rather than putting every stair below water. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "B24-STRUCT-001 — Reef Star Shrine — structural sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need star-plan wall/canopy wedges, shell capital/column seats, radial stair and dry-path/reef joins. Reuse source gold finials/tidal-rock vocabulary. Seagrass/seaweed are flora; actual living coral/polyps, fish and crustaceans are fauna, separate from coral-shaped stone carving. Tidal support unverified. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
